posts.title: Who is the Complaints Referee?
posts.description: I've written quite a lot about the outdated nature of surveillance oversight in Ireland (PDF), including its lack of transparency. This is highlighted by the fact that the state does not publish the identity of the Complaints Referee - the person responsible for investigating certain complaints about wrongful surveillance, interception of communications, and access to phone records. posts.title: Legitimate interest in practice: EDPB report on one stop shop decisions applying legitimate interest
